title: JSFL insertFrames/removeFrames only operates on active layer, not all selected layers
description: In runtime.ts, insertFrames(n, fi) calls insertFrame only on the current layer (getActiveLayerId()). Flash's timeline.insertFrames() simultaneously inserts frames on all selected layers to keep them synchronized. After calling insertFrames, all non-active layers remain out of sync, desynchronizing multi-layer content. Fix: apply frame insertion across all selected layers (or all layers) in a single mutation.
